statement: For a general Stewart–Gough platform, the explicit base points, platform points and six leg lengths in Table 2 produce 40 numerically distinct real direct-kinematic postures. Table 3 lists all 40 posture vectors, and Figures 3–4 display them. The example is obtained by deforming an initial design with six real postures and turning its 17 conjugate pairs into real pairs. This paper supplies numerical realization evidence, without an exact certification of these solutions.

answer.text: Explicit numerical Stewart–Gough design with 40 real postures; Table 3 lists the postures.
